findings: Four compiler profiles pass exact current full-record/protected-extent/public record comparisons; original non-iterator objects and original vector core are unchanged.
Clang14 changes the selected TEST byte register only, preserving iterator size and executed work.
Clang18 replaces the exceptional-arm stack-memory comparison with a register TEST: one fewer data read per visit, two static bytes smaller, same executed instruction count.
One GCC11 simulated-count increase occurs in byte-identical executables and only libc strchr/strcmp. It is a launch-state diagnostic, not evidence of candidate code generation.
parent_held_reason: R1461 still has cross-architecture native regressions.
